title: GLM-5.3 开源权重发布
summary: 智谱AI（Z.ai）正式发布了GLM-5.3模型，并开放其权重，供研究者和开发者使用。该模型在Hugging Face平台（zai-org/GLM-5.3）上提供下载，同时官方博客和社交媒体发布了详细的技术说明。GLM-5.3作为GLM系列的最新版本，在性能、推理能力和多任务处理上均有显著提升，尤其在自然语言理解、代码生成和复杂推理方面表现突出。此次开源权重意味着开发者可以自由下载、微调并部署该模型，极大地促进了AI技术的普及和创新。Hacker News上的讨论热度较高（390分，139条评论），反映了社区对国产大模型进展的高度关注。该发布对推动开源生态、降低大模型应用门槛具有重要意义，尤其对中文自然语言处理领域影响深远。
summary_en: Z.ai has officially released GLM-5.3 with open weights, available on Hugging Face (zai-org/GLM-5.3). The model showcases significant improvements in performance, reasoning, and multi-task capabilities, particularly in natural language understanding, code generation, and complex reasoning. Open-sourcing the weights allows developers to freely download, fine-tune, and deploy the model, fostering innovation and accessibility. The Hacker News community responded actively (390 points, 139 comments), reflecting high interest. This release is crucial for the open-source ecosystem and low-resource deployment, especially for Chinese NLP applications.
